longDescription: Spec-driven software development workflows for coding agents: structured planning and implementation, independent verification, and reusable engineering workflows. Includes standalone planning, debugging, implementation, review, and writing skills. Full SDD and Mini-SDD require isolated delegation and native development roles installed through the project installer; directory installation alone is not verified to register those roles. Local workflows require Git, project instructions, and Python 3.11+ for the full SDD contract checker.
